episodes.title: Blue Skies
episodes.summary: An unprecedented emergency sends Fairbanks into lockdown. Frank gathers every resource available to mount a full-scale response.

episodes.title: Wind of Change
episodes.summary: Luke tries to get back home as the manhunt for Havlock intensifies. Frank weighs whether he should give in to a set of demands.

episodes.title: Country as F**k
episodes.summary: Sarah's disappearance adds urgency to Frank's search. Havlock's master plan takes an unexpected turn, increasing the number of hostages.

episodes.title: American Dream
episodes.summary: A state trooper goes missing, widening Frank's investigation. Armed locals join the manhunt. Sarah grows concerned over Luke's whereabouts.

episodes.title: Arnaq
episodes.summary: Frank focuses on tracking down Luke. The CIA's involvement ramps up as Havlock's plan enters a new phase.

episodes.title: The Devil Wears a Suit and a Tie
episodes.summary: Fairbanks is hit with a mass power outage. Sarah spots someone suspicious in the ER. Sidney tries to get control of a key piece of evidence.

episodes.title: Change of Time
episodes.summary: A mysterious new suspect is interrogated. Frank's secret comes to light. Havlock works on retrieving the contents of his hard drive.

episodes.title: L'air Perdu
episodes.summary: Sidney learns about her father's past, the Atwater Protocol, and the classified intel in Archive 6.

episodes.title: Converge
episodes.summary: Bradford lands in Fairbanks with a CIA task force and new primary target. Sidney makes a desperate attempt to expose the truth.

episodes.title: Everything Trying
episodes.summary: Season finale. Sidney and Havlock risk it all to gain possession of the archive. Frank sets out on a life-saving mission.
